blocks.text: Jeremiah 33 contains 26 verses. It opens with: Moreover the word of Jehovah came unto Jeremiah the second time, while he was yet shut up in the court of the guard, saying, It concludes with: then will I also cast away the seed of Jacob, and of David my servant, so that I will not take of his seed to be rulers over the seed of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: for I will cause their captivity to return, and will have mercy on them.
